OVERVIEW: Prepare verified originals and an initial desired plan for a stopped
existing VM

Requires two local IPSWs and an independent boot ROM. Installed ROM, Restore
and Disk.img are not replaced. Existing desired plans are refused. If
desired-plan publication is uncertain, use fw desired-plan --readback; retained
generations are evidence, not an installed-firmware receipt.

USAGE: vphone-cli fw generation-prepare [--library-root <library-root>] [<name>] --iphone-source <iphone-source> --cloudos-source <cloudos-source> --boot-rom-source <boot-rom-source> [--variant <variant>] [--frida] [--force-exc-guard]

ARGUMENTS:
  <name>                  VM name

OPTIONS:
  -l, --library-root <library-root>
                          VM library root (default: ~/.vphone/VMs or
                          $VPHONE_LIBRARY_ROOT)
  --iphone-source <iphone-source>
                          Explicit local iPhone IPSW path
  --cloudos-source <cloudos-source>
                          Explicit local cloudOS IPSW path
  --boot-rom-source <boot-rom-source>
                          Independent original boot ROM path outside the VM
  -V, --variant <variant> variant: regular | dev | jb | exp (values: less,
                          regular, dev, jb, exp; default: regular)
  --frida                 Opt in to Frida kernel relaxations
  --force-exc-guard       Force the EXC_GUARD disable patch
  -h, --help              Show help information.

OVERVIEW: Update a stopped VM kernel from its frozen desired plan, or recover
an interrupted update

Run the CLI from the VM's verified Core Bundle. The VM must be stopped and
Disk.img detached. The update preserves the Preboot IM4M and refuses an
incompatible installed DSC. Recovery reads the existing journal without
rerunning patches.

USAGE: vphone-cli vm update-kernel [--library-root <library-root>] [<name>] [--recover]

ARGUMENTS:
  <name>                  VM name

OPTIONS:
  -l, --library-root <library-root>
                          VM library root (default: ~/.vphone/VMs or
                          $VPHONE_LIBRARY_ROOT)
  --recover               Recover the pending kernel transaction without
                          rerunning its producer
  -h, --help              Show help information.
